answer: Sybil resistance is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a slashable bond to earn one vote, so forging k personas needs k bonds. In this atlas of agents, identity is priced by capital, not by keys. An attacker in a sable cloak who splits one wallet into many falcon clones forfeits the full collateral on every double-sign, gaining no extra weight. Each fake account is thus a sunk, punishable cost.
